x.description: array of shape ``(..., M, N)`` for which to compute the condition number.

p.description: the order of the norm to use. One of ``{None, 1, -1, 2, -2, inf, -inf, 'fro'}``;
constraints: p must be one of fro

see.description: func:`jax.numpy.linalg.norm` for the meaning of these. The default is ``p = None``, which is equivalent to ``p = 2``. If not in ``{None, 2, -2}`` then ``x`` must be square, i.e. ``M = N``.

output.description: array of shape ``x.shape[:-2]`` containing the condition number.
